title: Switzerland Explorer
priceDetail: Starting per person based on twin sharing
overview: Journey through the snow-capped majesty of the Swiss Alps. From the car-free mountain village of Zermatt in the shadow of the Matterhorn to the crystal-clear alpine waters of Lake Brienz and Zurich's cosmopolitan charm, this bespoke expedition balances first-class panoramic rail transit with intimate luxury chalet stays.
atmosphereQuote: Where glacier breezes meet five-star alpine hospitality and the silence of the highest peaks.
bestTimeToVisit: May to October (Alpine Trails) or Dec to April (Ski & Snow)
transferType: First Class Swiss Panoramic Rail & Private Mercedes V-Class
highlights: Direct Matterhorn views from your private chalet balcony
First-Class panoramic ride aboard the iconic Glacier Express
Private yacht excursion across turquoise Lake Thun and Lake Brienz
Helicopter flight over Jungfraujoch & Aletsch Glacier (optional)
Curated fondue and wine pairing in a centuries-old cellar

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich & First-Class Scenic Rail to Zermatt
itinerary.description: Upon arrival at Zurich Airport (ZRH), your JJ Travels representative greets you at the terminal and escorts your party to the first-class Swiss rail concourse. Board the scenic panoramic train winding through the Valais valley before reaching the car-free sanctuary of Zermatt.
itinerary.morning: VIP airport reception and private baggage porterage.
itinerary.afternoon: Ascend through the mountain valleys on the Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn.
itinerary.evening: Check into your private suite facing the Matterhorn followed by a welcome alpine dinner.
itinerary.stay: The Omnia Mountain Lodge or Grand Hotel Zermatterhof (5★)
itinerary.meals: Welcome Dinner with Swiss Vintage Pairings

itinerary.title: Gornergrat Mountain Summit & Matterhorn Reflection Lakes
itinerary.description: Board the historic open-air cogwheel railway up to Gornergrat at 3,089 meters. Witness 29 four-thousand-meter peaks surrounding you. Embark on a gentle private downhill trail to the pristine Riffelsee where the Matterhorn mirrors flawlessly in still glacial waters.
itinerary.morning: Ascent on the Gornergrat Bahn with priority cabin seating.
itinerary.afternoon: Private picnic lunch prepared by your lodge on the alpine meadow.
itinerary.evening: Fireside thermal spa relaxation and five-course seasonal degustation.

itinerary.title: Glacier Express Excellence Class to Andermatt
itinerary.description: Board the world-famous Glacier Express in Excellence Class. Sink into handcrafted leather armchairs with guaranteed window seating, personal concierge service, and a five-course gourmet lunch paired with regional vintages as the train traverses 291 bridges and the Oberalp Pass.
itinerary.morning: Private transfer via electric horse carriage to Zermatt station.
itinerary.afternoon: Panoramic traverse across dramatic viaducts and gorges with sommelier service.
itinerary.evening: Arrival in the luxury alpine hub of Andermatt; check-in at The Chedi.

itinerary.title: Interlaken Lakes, Lauterbrunnen Waterfalls & Jungfraujoch
itinerary.description: Chauffeured transit into the Lauterbrunnen Valley of 72 waterfalls. Take the state-of-the-art Eiger Express tricable gondola to Jungfraujoch — the Top of Europe at 3,454m. Step onto the eternal ice and tour the mystical Ice Palace.
itinerary.morning: Scenic drive through alpine passes and Lauterbrunnen valley.
itinerary.afternoon: Jungfraujoch summit excursion with private mountain guide.
itinerary.evening: Sunset cruise on Lake Brienz aboard an exclusive private wooden speedboat.

itinerary.title: Lucerne & The Historic Chapel Bridge
itinerary.description: Travel across the Brünig Pass to the medieval lakeside city of Lucerne. Stroll across the 14th-century wooden Chapel Bridge, explore the Old Town ramparts, and visit bespoke Swiss horology ateliers with an expert curator.
itinerary.morning: Panoramic lakeshore drive with photo stops at Giessbach Falls.
itinerary.afternoon: Private guided historical walk and Swiss watchmaker atelier tour.
itinerary.evening: Lakeside dining at a Michelin-recommended terrace in Lucerne.
itinerary.stay: Bürgenstock Hotel & Alpine Spa or Mandarin Oriental Palace (5★)

itinerary.title: Zurich Old Town, Bahnhofstrasse & Lake Sunset
itinerary.description: Seamless morning transfer to Zurich. Check in at your historic lakeside hotel. Spend the afternoon exploring the vibrant Lindenhof district and premier boutiques along the world-renowned Bahnhofstrasse.
itinerary.morning: Private Mercedes transfer along Lake Zurich.
itinerary.afternoon: Private art tour through Kunsthaus Zurich or VIP shopping consultation.
itinerary.evening: Farewell champagne toast and gala dinner overlooking the Limmat River.
itinerary.stay: The Dolder Grand or Baur au Lac (5★ Superior)

itinerary.title: Bespoke Departure Concierge
itinerary.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast terrace overlooking the lake. Your private chauffeur transfers you to Zurich Airport with VIP fast-track security access arranged by JJ Travels.
itinerary.morning: Breakfast at leisure and optional last-minute Swiss chocolate tasting.
itinerary.afternoon: Private airport VIP transfer and homeward departure.

inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation in handpicked 5-Star luxury chalets and historic palace hotels
Daily gourmet champagne breakfasts and 4 curated multi-course dinners
First-Class Swiss Travel Pass with seat reservations and Excellence Class Glacier Express
Private Mercedes V-Class chauffeur services for all road transits
Private boat charter across Lake Brienz / Lake Lucerne
All mountain railway and cable car permits including Gornergrat and Jungfraujoch
Dedicated 24/7 JJ Travels concierge coordinator on WhatsApp and phone
Full baggage handling and private airport VIP reception
exclusions: International flights (Can be seamlessly booked by our Flight Desk)
Discretionary gratuities for guides and chauffeurs
Travel insurance coverage (Comprehensive policies available upon request)
Personal boutique expenses and incidental room charges

accommodations.name: The Chedi Andermatt
accommodations.description: Combining traditional Swiss alpine warmth with Asian serenity. Features bronze fireplaces, dark woods, an Olympic-length indoor pool, and a wine and cigar library.

title: Bali Serenity Escape
priceDetail: Starting per person based on twin sharing
overview: Escape to the enchanting island of the gods. From the mist-draped rice terraces and spiritual temples of Ubud to the private cliffside beaches and tranquil azure waters of Nusa Dua, this handpicked itinerary is designed for travelers seeking rejuvenation, culture, and pure tropical barefoot luxury.
atmosphereQuote: Frangipani aromas in the morning breeze, infinity pools overlooking emerald valleys, and timeless ocean horizons.
bestTimeToVisit: April to October (Dry & Sunny Island Season)
accommodationType: Private Pool River Villas & 5-Star Oceanfront Suites
highlights: Exclusive sunrise view of the floating Ulun Danu Beratan Temple
Private pool villa with hanging valley views in Ubud
Private yacht day-sail to Nusa Penida's secret beaches
Authentic Balinese organic culinary class with a private chef
Sunset seafood banquet directly on the white sands of Jimbaran

itinerary.title: Arrival in Denpasar & Private Scenic Transit to Ubud
itinerary.description: Touch down at Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) where your personal chauffeur greets you with cold towels and fragrant jasmine leis. Journey into the lush highlands of Ubud and settle into your jungle pool sanctuary.
itinerary.morning: VIP immigration assistance and airport greeting.
itinerary.afternoon: Check in at your riverside pool villa; rest and refresh.
itinerary.evening: Welcome Balinese herbal blessing ceremony and three-course dinner.
itinerary.stay: Mandapa, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve or Viceroy Bali (5★)

itinerary.title: Tegallalang Terraces, Tirta Empul & Private Chef Experience
itinerary.description: Early morning access to Tegallalang rice terraces before the crowds. Receive a traditional water purification blessing at the holy springs of Tirta Empul with an authorized local guide.
itinerary.morning: Sunrise stroll along emerald paddy walks and swing photo stop.
itinerary.afternoon: Organic farm tour and cooking masterclass with village elders.
itinerary.evening: Relaxing 90-minute Balinese deep tissue massage in your villa.

itinerary.title: Ulun Danu Beratan & Transfer to Nusa Dua Coastline
itinerary.description: Witness the famous 17th-century water temple Pura Ulun Danu Beratan on Lake Beratan, followed by an afternoon scenic drive south to the white powder sands of Nusa Dua.
itinerary.morning: Highland lake drive and lakeside temple exploration.
itinerary.afternoon: Oceanfront check-in at your Nusa Dua resort with private beach access.
itinerary.evening: Beachside cocktail reception and dinner under the stars.
itinerary.stay: The St. Regis Bali Resort or The Mulia (5★ Oceanfront)

itinerary.title: Private Catamaran Cruise to Nusa Penida
itinerary.description: Step aboard a private 45-foot catamaran for a full-day cruise across the Badung Strait. Snorkel in crystal clear waters with manta rays at Manta Bay and relax on secluded coves.
itinerary.morning: Yacht embarkation with champagne and tropical fruits.
itinerary.afternoon: Snorkeling, paddle-boarding, and gourmet onboard lunch.
itinerary.evening: Sunset return to Nusa Dua followed by free evening at leisure.
itinerary.stay: The St. Regis Bali Resort (5★ Oceanfront)

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Sunset Temple & Farewell Departure
itinerary.description: Spend your final morning swimming and enjoying spa treatments. In the afternoon, visit the dramatic clifftop temple of Uluwatu before your private chauffeur transfers you to Denpasar Airport for your onward flight.
itinerary.morning: Leisurely beach walk and resort breakfast buffet.
itinerary.afternoon: Clifftop panoramic views at Uluwatu; airport transfer.

Daily gourmet breakfasts and 3 specially arranged multi-course dinners
Private air-conditioned vehicle with dedicated English-speaking driver

accommodations.description: Nestled on the premier white sands of Nusa Dua with a 9,288-square-meter saltwater lagoon, dedicated round-the-clock St. Regis Butler Service, and world-class culinary experiences.

title: Dubai Luxury Getaway
priceDetail: Starting per person based on twin sharing
overview: Experience Dubai's architectural wonders and Arabian heritage with utmost VIP privilege. From fast-track Burj Khalifa sky access and private mega-yacht marina cruising to sleeping under star-filled desert skies in an ultra-exclusive conservation reserve, this journey delivers modern Arabian opulence at its highest standard.
atmosphereQuote: Golden desert dunes melting into futuristic skyline silhouettes crowned by the world's tallest spires.
bestTimeToVisit: October to April (Pleasant Warm Winter Season)
accommodationType: 5-Star Downtown Palace Hotel & Luxury Desert Oasis Resort
transferType: Private Mercedes S-Class Chauffeur & Luxury 4x4 Desert Transport

Private sunset yacht charter cruising past Atlantis The Royal and Palm Jumeirah
Private vintage Land Rover safari through the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve
Five-star private dune dining accompanied by classical oud performance
Exclusive shopping concierge and personal stylist session at Dubai Mall

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Sunset Yacht Cruise
itinerary.description: Touch down at Dubai International Airport (DXB) with VIP fast-track Marhaba escort. Transfer in a private Mercedes S-Class to your Downtown luxury suite. At golden hour, embark on a private 55-foot yacht sailing through Dubai Marina and around the Palm Jumeirah.
itinerary.morning: VIP Marhaba airport meet & assist.
itinerary.afternoon: Check-in at your Downtown hotel overlooking Burj Lake.
itinerary.evening: Private sunset yacht charter with canapés and sparkling drinks.

itinerary.title: Burj Khalifa SKY VIP, Dubai Mall & Museum of the Future
itinerary.description: Skip the general queues with priority elevator access to Level 148 of the Burj Khalifa. Enjoy Arabic dates and coffee in the luxury sky lounge. In the afternoon, tour the architecturally astonishing Museum of the Future.
itinerary.morning: At The Top SKY Level 148 VIP lounge experience.
itinerary.afternoon: Guided tour through the Museum of the Future.
itinerary.evening: Front-row dining at At.mosphere restaurant or Armani/Ristorante.

itinerary.title: Al Maha Desert Conservation Reserve & Royal Dune Dinner
itinerary.description: Depart the bustling metropolis for the serene sands of the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve. Check in to your private tented suite with an infinity plunge pool gazing across roaming Arabian oryx and gazelles.
itinerary.morning: Scenic desert transfer in a luxury 4x4 vehicle.
itinerary.afternoon: Wildlife drive in a 1950s vintage open-top Land Rover.
itinerary.evening: Private candlelit silver-service dinner set atop secluded desert dunes.
itinerary.stay: Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa (5★)

itinerary.title: Sunrise Falconry & Departure
itinerary.description: Witness the ancient art of Bedouin falconry at dawn over the dunes. Enjoy a tranquil breakfast by your private pool before your chauffeur conveys you directly to Dubai Airport for departure.
itinerary.morning: Interactive sunrise falconry experience and champagne breakfast.
itinerary.afternoon: Private Mercedes airport transfer with fast-track check-in.

Private Mercedes S-Class transfers for all city transits

accommodations.description: An authentic oasis secluded among the golden dunes. Features individual Bedouin-style suites, handcrafted Arabian antiquities, and individual temperature-controlled plunge pools overlooking desert wildlife.

title: Amalfi Coast & Capri Odyssey
priceDetail: Starting per person based on twin sharing
overview: Indulge in the world's most romantic coastal sanctuary. Clinging to vertical lemon-scented cliffs above the sapphire Tyrrhenian Sea, the Amalfi Coast and glamorous Isle of Capri combine timeless Italian dolce vita with cliffside Michelin dining and private Riva boat excursions.
atmosphereQuote: Cliffside bougainvillea, crisp limoncello spritz, and the rhythmic lap of waves against legendary sea grottos.
bestTimeToVisit: May to October (Glorious Mediterranean Summer & Autumn)
accommodationType: 5-Star Historic Cliffside Palazzos & Luxury Sea Suites
transferType: Private Mercedes Minivan & Classic Italian Wooden Speedboats
highlights: Private balcony looking straight over Positano's pastel cascades
Full-day private Riva yacht charter around Capri and the Blue Grotto
Walk the Path of the Gods with a private naturalist guide
Candlelit cliffside dining overlooking the Faraglioni sea stacks
Private vintage Fiat 500 scenic coast drive through Ravello

itinerary.title: Arrival in Naples & Dramatic Cliffside Drive to Positano
itinerary.description: Private greeting at Naples Airport (NAP) or Centrale Train Station. Your chauffeur drives you along the dramatic cliff roads of the Amalfi coastline, arriving in picturesque Positano.
itinerary.morning: Private Mercedes reception in Naples.
itinerary.afternoon: Check in at your cliffside palazzo suite overlooking the sea.
itinerary.evening: Aperitivo on your private terrace followed by fresh seafood pasta dinner.
itinerary.stay: Le Sirenuse or Villa Franca Positano (5★ Luxury)

itinerary.title: Positano Beaches, Boutiques & Ravello Cliff Gardens
itinerary.description: Explore Positano's narrow cobbled stairs and artisan linen boutiques before driving up to the tranquil hilltown of Ravello. Tour the hanging infinity gardens of Villa Cimbrone with panoramic views.
itinerary.morning: Leisurely Positano harbor walk and artisanal shopping.
itinerary.afternoon: Private transfer to Ravello; stroll through Villa Cimbrone & Villa Rufolo.
itinerary.evening: Limoncello tasting and dinner in Ravello's panoramic plaza.

itinerary.title: Private Wooden Gozzo Sail to Isle of Capri
itinerary.description: Board a private 38-foot classic Italian wooden Gozzo boat with your private skipper. Cruise past the Li Galli islands to Capri. Swim in secluded coves, navigate through the Faraglioni arches, and explore Anacapri.
itinerary.morning: Board private boat at Positano pier with chilled prosecco.
itinerary.afternoon: Tender access to Capri port, chairlift to Monte Solaro, and Blue Grotto visit.
itinerary.evening: Sunset sail back to Positano as the cliffside lights begin to glow.

itinerary.title: Path of the Gods Hike & Historic Amalfi Town
itinerary.description: Hike the legendary 'Sentiero degli Dei' with breathtaking views suspended 500 meters between sky and sea. In the afternoon, visit the 9th-century Duomo di Sant'Andrea in Amalfi town.
itinerary.morning: Scenic guided morning hike along the cliffside crest.
itinerary.afternoon: Explore historic Amalfi town and taste traditional sfogliatella.
itinerary.evening: Michelin-starred cliffside dinner at Ristorante La Sponda.

itinerary.title: Sorrento Coast & Lemon Grove Gastronomy
itinerary.description: Journey along the Sorrento peninsula to an authentic family-run citrus estate. Learn traditional mozzarella making, pick fresh Amalfi lemons, and dine on wood-fired Neapolitan pizza in the groves.
itinerary.morning: Sorrento peninsula drive and artisan leather workshops.
itinerary.afternoon: Private mozzarella and pizza masterclass under lemon trees.
itinerary.evening: Farewell sunset toast overlooking the Bay of Naples.

itinerary.title: Arrivederci Amalfi & Chauffeur to Naples
itinerary.description: Savor your final morning espresso on the terrace listening to the sea. Your private driver transfers you to Naples Airport for your flight home.
itinerary.morning: Terrace breakfast at leisure.
itinerary.afternoon: Private Mercedes transfer to Naples Airport (NAP).

inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in 5★ cliffside luxury suites with sea views
Daily artisan Italian breakfasts and 3 specially curated regional dinners

title: Santorini Caldera Haven
priceDetail: Starting per person based on twin sharing

Whitewashed cliff dwellings, private heated infinity plunge pools, world-renowned Oia sunsets, and private catamaran sailing across crystalline volcanic hot springs.
atmosphereQuote: Cobalt domes glowing against golden Aegean sunsets and the timeless peace of ancient volcanic cliffs.
bestTimeToVisit: April to October (Dry Aegean Sunshine & Warm Seas)
accommodationType: 5-Star Caldera Cave Suites with Private Heated Pools
transferType: Private Luxury Airport Transfer & Catamaran Charters
highlights: Private terrace with heated caldera plunge pool in Oia
Private sunset catamaran cruise with fresh seafood BBQ and Greek wine
Wine tasting tour through 3 heritage volcanic vineyards with sommelier
Guided sunset walk from Imerovigli to Oia along the caldera ridge
Helicopter transfer from Athens or private island hopping (optional)

itinerary.title: Arrival in Santorini & Check-In to Your Cliffside Cave Suite
itinerary.description: Private airport reception upon arrival in Santorini. Journey to the iconic village of Oia. Check in to your sculpted cave suite featuring a private heated plunge pool perched hundreds of feet above the sea.
itinerary.morning: Private airport reception and porter service through Oia's steps.
itinerary.afternoon: Check in and unwind in your private cliffside pool.
itinerary.evening: Champagne sunset toast on your private terrace followed by caldera dining.
itinerary.stay: Canaves Oia Suites or Mystique, a Luxury Collection Hotel (5★)

itinerary.title: Volcanic Vineyards & Megalochori Heritage Village
itinerary.description: Meet your private sommelier for a tour through Santorini's unique basket-woven Assyrtiko vineyards. Visit historic stone cellars, taste award-winning volcanic wines, and explore the peaceful medieval village of Megalochori.
itinerary.morning: Scenic drive through southern Santorini to traditional villages.
itinerary.afternoon: Private tasting of 8 volcanic wines paired with Cycladic cheeses.
itinerary.evening: Dinner overlooking the illuminated caldera in Imerovigli.

itinerary.title: Private Catamaran Cruise across Volcanic Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Board a luxury 50-foot catamaran for a semi-private or private sailing expedition. Swim in the thermal waters of the volcanic hot springs, snorkel at Red Beach and White Beach, and savor an Aegean seafood BBQ cooked on deck.
itinerary.morning: Embarkation at Ammoudi Bay with morning swim stops.
itinerary.afternoon: Snorkeling at White Beach and grilled lobster lunch on deck.
itinerary.evening: Anchor beneath Oia to watch the world's most celebrated sunset from the water.

itinerary.title: Akrotiri Prehistoric City & Red Beach Scenic Walk
itinerary.description: Step into history with a private archaeologist guide through the preserved ruins of Akrotiri, the 'Minoan Pompeii' buried beneath volcanic ash in 1600 BC.
itinerary.morning: Guided tour through prehistoric Akrotiri excavations.
itinerary.afternoon: Relax on the black sand shores of Perivolos with private cabana access.
itinerary.evening: Farewell candlelight dinner in an ancient stone windmill restaurant.

itinerary.title: Aegean Farewell & Chauffeur to Airport
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final morning taking in the panoramic views over a Greek breakfast of local honey, fresh figs, and Greek yogurt before your chauffeur whisks you to the airport.
itinerary.morning: Terrace breakfast overlooking the caldera.
itinerary.afternoon: Private airport transfer with expedited luggage assistance.

Daily champagne breakfasts served on your private terrace
Private sunset catamaran cruise with seafood lunch and open bar

title: Alpine Scenic Rail & St. Moritz
priceDetail: Starting per person based on twin sharing
overview: A grand journey across Switzerland's UNESCO World Heritage rail lines. Cross the monumental Landwasser and Solis viaducts aboard vintage panorama trains, traverse the Bernina Pass into Italian palm valleys, and stay in legendary palace hotels in St. Moritz and Pontresina.
atmosphereQuote: Engineering brilliance meeting dramatic alpine gorges and the legendary glamour of St. Moritz.
bestTimeToVisit: Year-Round (Winter Wonderland Dec–Apr, Alpine Bloom Jun–Oct)
accommodationType: 5-Star Historic Palace Hotels & Grand Heritage Lodges
transferType: First Class UNESCO Panoramic Rail & Chauffeur Concierge
highlights: Traverse the UNESCO World Heritage Albula and Bernina rail lines
First-Class panoramic carriages over the 65-meter Landwasser Viaduct
3 Nights at the legendary Badrutt's Palace Hotel in St. Moritz
Private horse-drawn carriage ride through Val Fex pine forests
Thermal mineral wellness baths nestled amidst snow-capped peaks

itinerary.title: Arrival in Zurich & Bernina Express to Chur
itinerary.description: Arrive in Zurich and board your first-class rail connection to Chur, Switzerland's oldest city. Settle into a boutique heritage hotel and explore medieval cobbled alleys.
itinerary.morning: VIP Zurich Airport greeting and rail escort.
itinerary.afternoon: Scenic rail along Lake Zurich and Lake Walen to Chur.
itinerary.evening: Welcome dinner in a 500-year-old guild hall.

itinerary.title: Crossing the Landwasser Viaduct to St. Moritz
itinerary.description: Board the iconic Rhätische Bahn in panoramic first class. Experience the breathtaking moment the train curves across the soaring arches of the Landwasser Viaduct into a sheer rock cliff tunnel.
itinerary.morning: Embark on the UNESCO Albula Railway route.
itinerary.afternoon: Arrival in St. Moritz; private carriage transfer to Badrutt's Palace.
itinerary.evening: Cocktails in the Grand Hall overlooking Lake St. Moritz.

itinerary.title: Bernina Express Traverse across the Alps into Italy
itinerary.description: The ultimate rail spectacle: climb past the Morteratsch Glacier to 2,253 meters at Ospizio Bernina before descending via the Brusio Circular Viaduct into the Italian vineyards of Tirano.
itinerary.morning: Bernina Express departure with private cabin service.
itinerary.afternoon: Authentic Valtellina pasta lunch in historic Tirano, Italy.
itinerary.evening: Return to St. Moritz in time for thermal spa relaxation.

itinerary.title: Horse-Drawn Carriage into Val Fex & High Alpine Tea
itinerary.description: Travel to the peaceful village of Sils Maria. Step into a private horse-drawn wooden carriage journeying deep into the protected, car-free alpine valley of Val Fex.
itinerary.morning: Lake Sils scenic promenade.
itinerary.afternoon: Carriage ride into Val Fex with private alpine picnic.
itinerary.evening: Fondue Chinoise and Swiss wines in a mountain lodge.

itinerary.title: Muottas Muragl Sunset Funicular & Stargazing
itinerary.description: Ride the century-old funicular railway up to Muottas Muragl for the most acclaimed panorama of the Upper Engadin lake plateau at sunset.
itinerary.morning: Leisure morning in St. Moritz boutiques and mineral baths.
itinerary.afternoon: Ascend Muottas Muragl with private panoramic hike.
itinerary.evening: Sunset dinner at the summit restaurant with views of the valley lights.

itinerary.title: Thermal Spas of Pontresina & Glacier Views
itinerary.description: A day dedicated to restorative alpine wellness. Indulge in hydrotherapy baths, saltwater grottoes, and mineral pools overlooking ancient pine forests.
itinerary.morning: Morning yoga and hydrotherapy spa treatment.
itinerary.afternoon: Walk to the foot of the Morteratsch Glacier trail.
itinerary.evening: Five-course Grand Restaurant gala dining.

itinerary.title: Glacier Express to Andermatt & Lucerne
itinerary.description: Embark on the legendary Glacier Express through the Rhine Gorge ('The Swiss Grand Canyon') before connecting to Lucerne for your final celebration night.
itinerary.morning: Scenic gorge traverse aboard the Glacier Express.
itinerary.afternoon: Check-in at your Lucerne lakeside palace hotel.
itinerary.evening: Farewell champagne dinner overlooking the Chapel Bridge.

itinerary.description: Conclude your grand Swiss railway expedition with a private transfer along Lake Zurich directly to Zurich Airport for your flight.
itinerary.morning: Leisurely breakfast on the lake terrace.
itinerary.afternoon: Private Mercedes VIP transfer to Zurich Airport.

accommodations.name: Badrutt's Palace Hotel
accommodations.description: An icon of legendary alpine hospitality since 1896. Perched over Lake St. Moritz with Gothic revival towers, celebrity guest pedigree, Palace Spa, and world-class service.
